b.label: Roswell, New Mexico and the Foster Ranch, Lincoln County

edges.label: GAO found the relevant RAAF records destroyed with no recorded authority
edges.note: RAAF administrative records March 1945-December 1949 and outgoing messages October 1946-December 1949 were destroyed; the disposition form records neither who destroyed them nor under what authority.

edges.label: The corpus is what survives the records fight
edges.note: Almost every primary document in this field arrived through FOIA or archival release; historiography here is downstream of records law.

edges.label: Site to container to shelf
edges.note: The custody chain begins at the recovery site; every documented handoff is a scoring opportunity on the C axis.

edges.label: Where the disc became a balloon
edges.note: The Roswell debris was flown to Eighth Air Force headquarters at Fort Worth, where it was presented to the press as a weather balloon the same day.

edges.label: Four official explanations for one event
edges.note: Weather balloon in 1947, Project MOGUL in the mid-1990s, crash test dummies in 1997 - the sequence of explanations is itself the evidentiary object.

edges.label: The founding case of the retrieval strand
edges.note: Roswell is the origin of the crash-retrieval literature and the case against which every later retrieval claim is measured.

b.label: GAO/NSIAD-95-187 - Results of a Search for Records Concerning the 1947 Crash Near Roswell

edges.label: Schiff tasked GAO after DoD refused to answer him
edges.note: A single member of Congress used the legislature's audit arm to go around an executive agency, producing the records-destruction finding no executive review has ever addressed.

edges.label: Record destruction as concealment
edges.note: GAO found Roswell AAF outgoing messages for 1946-1949 destroyed with no disposition authority and no destruction certificate - concealment executed through the records system.

b.label: GAO/NSIAD-95-187 - Results of a Search for Records Concerning the 1947 Crash Near Roswell

edges.label: The initiative's live period coincides with the GAO records audit and its retention in the White House Roswell file
edges.note: The Clinton White House Roswell file (2006-0476-F) contains the July 1995 GAO report; the unclassified records audit is what the White House ended up holding.
